# src

TypeScript implementation of the local-router proxy.

## Purpose

- Express server entry point and route wiring.
- Provider implementations (Ollama, OpenRouter, Groq).
- Routing decision logic: auto-router, fallback chains, router candidates.
- Config UI HTML renderers and API route registration.
- Streaming, reasoning, sessions, diagnostics, pricing, and PQC secrets loading.

## Ownership

- Maintained by the local-router team.
- `src/index.ts` is the primary system-of-record for router behavior and side effects.

## Local Contracts

- Use only FIPS 203/204/205 algorithms for secrets operations.
- No secrets in source code; provider keys loaded via environment or PQC bundle.
- All output formats (`openai`, `ollama_chat`, `ollama_generate`, `openai_responses`) must stay backward compatible.

## Work Guidance

- Prefer extending existing router abstractions over introducing new provider adapters.
- UI pages must render only via `renderLayout` and avoid external assets.
- Model IDs and routing order must remain deterministic when possible.

## Verification

- Run `npm test` and targeted `node --test` suites for routing, fallback, responses streams.

## Child DOX Index

No child DOX files are required; all guidance is contained here.
